criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Birth Of Farmuken
criterion.wasted_life: letting Birth Of Farmuken slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: sells iron work at the market through the day, counts deliveries against seasons he's only heard described, hasn't yet had a bad one of his own

arc.premise: Mekobaluk has stopped renegotiating paper terms and started placing one real, unhedged iron order at ordinary rates - taking the delivery himself as the actual test of whether the arrears settlement holds, not another clause in a contract.
